:::{#exm-poisson-natural-parameter}
#### The natural parameter of the Poisson distribution is the log rate

In @exm-poisson-exponential-family,
the [Poisson](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/distributions.html#def-poisson) rate $\rate$ and the [natural parameter](#def-natural-parameter) $\natparam$ are related by

$$
\natparam = \logf{\rate}
\qquad \text{and} \qquad
\rate = \expf{\natparam}
$$

For the cyclone data, the rate set to the [sample mean](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-mean) is
`r round(rate, 3)` cyclones per season,
so the natural parameter is $\natparam = `r round(natural_parameter, 3)`$.
The natural parameter can be any real number,
while the rate must be greater than zero.
:::
